rapport_notes: Professional and patient but fairly transactional/monologue-heavy compared to other calls in this batch.

evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer said 'I don't know and there's no way for me to know... you know what happens' about box-count uncertainty; rep answered once ('then I'll just let us know so we can adjust') without probing further.

top_strength: Adapted smoothly when the customer wanted his wife to join the virtual walkthrough on a different number instead.
coaching_note: Two real concerns surfaced organically (box-count uncertainty, full-house packing cost) and each got only a single answer — a follow-up would have deepened trust before the walkthrough handoff.
